verdict.rationale: Freshsales documents a REST API with endpoints such as /api/leads, /api/deals and /api/lists, but only as human-readable reference pages. Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Since a downloadable spec is a fair question for any SaaS CRM with a public API, the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
